reused_evidence.purpose: Parent open replay target edge at use-realtime-sync.ts:896
Conservative superset of query-factory reads; IDs and factory evidence reused verbatim
Existing shared WS handshake/frame contract; no new route

semantics.replay: replayRealtimeEvent -> observer.onEvent(replayed=true) -> runWithSyncCauses -> registered ws.replay -> own exact-type handlers(payload,actor_id,actor_type), then own onAny(msg). No socket send, no WSClient.dispatch, no external useWSEvent subscribers, no reconnect callbacks. Central handlers can read HTTP, update caches, notify, navigate.
semantics.drop: dropRealtimeConnection -> target.drop -> WSClient.drop -> socket.close -> onclose scheduleReconnect -> connect existing configured WS URL -> cookie authentication or first auth frame -> auth_ack/onAuthenticated -> recovered callbacks -> invalidateWorkspaceScopedQueries. Other application reconnect subscribers are outside replay target and must not be called replay coverage.
semantics.cache: setQueryData/setQueriesData/getQueryData/removeQueries/cancelQueries are local cache operations; invalidateQueries marks matching keys stale and normally refetches enabled active queries; refetchType none suppresses immediate refetch. ensureQueryData fetches on cache miss; fetchQuery obeys freshness. Predicates narrow the conservative factory union. No runtime observer enumeration required.
semantics.causes: Synchronous cause context does not propagate automatically across await. debounce, task batching, aggregate and working-agent paths explicitly hold/reapply causes where coded; project activity timer has no explicit cause restoration. Recorder write refusal is not a global no-network guarantee.

boundaries: hooks useWSEvent/useWSReconnect accept caller callbacks; hooks only subscribe/unsubscribe. Arbitrary caller bodies are not replay targets. useWSStatus only external-store status.
Provider user/slug/url/auth gates connection; cleanup disconnect suppresses reconnect. Search-index hook is separate existing search-index transport scope; not ws.replay subscriber.

Native desktopAPI.showNotification is injected callback boundary; no desktop implementation closure claimed. Web Notification onclick focuses and WebNotificationBridge pushes source inbox/chat path. Destination mount/mark-read is subsequent navigation, excluded from replay read union.

onToast is injected optional UI callback; auth/workspace cleanup, GitHub connection/chat stores, local search forgetting and browser location navigation are separate local/navigation effects. No invented native HTTP route.
verification: Static source ledger and existing ID reuse only; no runtime, network, shared inventory, data or Git changes.
parent_review: Accepted three target modules plus observer/recorder after replay target boundary closure. Verified complete central source segments against disk, inventory IDs/routes, read provider/hooks completely, checked exact handler replay and drop versus disconnect. Conservative request union is an upper bound; supporting files are not promoted.
